remarks: Wow!! - Totally renovated from top to bottom! - Great 3 bedroom, 2 full bath apartment on the 2nd floor, with private patio space! - New kitchen with white shaker style cabinets, granite counters, and stainless steel appliances - Master bedroom features stunning en suite bath with custom tile shower & glass door + walk-in closet! - Second bedroom also features a walk-in closet - Hallway bathroom features double sink vanity - Hardwood floors throughout - Custom closet systems in each bedroom - Recessed lighting - Washer / dryer in separate laundry room within unit - Private driveway & garage just for this unit! - Walk to multiple restaurants and easy access to The Wall Street area & SoNo - no pets!!
